## [1.171.0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.170.1...v1.171.0) (2026-10-31)

### Features

* **carousel:** the standard control names the setting it changes, not its value (brandon-menus-sjhy.vxr) ([#518](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/518)) ([e0b1483](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/e0b1483c0864fe01633d47904d1f453e411b8da2))
chore(decor): the plane's role is private to decor, and the band says why it is lazy (brandon-menus-sjhy.ju8)
test(effect): comments say what the total palette and the wheel do, and fixture roles are typed (brandon-menus-sjhy.ju8)
fix(effect): the bar's frame names only what drew it, and the docs say a moved segment changes colour (brandon-menus-sjhy.ju8)

feat(effect): the wheel turns each segment at a pace set by where it sits (brandon-menus-sjhy.ju8)

The wheel lives in rich-js, and 0.27.0 reads a segment's place from the
frame it is handed, so moving to it is the feature and the row wrapping
here does not change.

0.27.0's Palette is built from a total set of roles, so paletteRole's
undefined branch cannot run. paletteRole, DecorRole and ThemePole go, and
so do the two tests of a palette that can no longer be built.
